quests.name: A Stone Among Stones
quests.offer: Ho, a new giant on the plateau! Before you go stomping off, every young one of the clan greets Bulka. She keeps the meat pits by the old steps, and no giant marches hungry while she has a say.
quests.declined: The plateau is patient. So am I.
quests.started: Go on. Bulka is just west of here, by the pits.

steps.journal: Greet Grocer Bulka by the meat pits west of the old steps.
steps.says: Hrolmog sent you? Then eat this, and grow bigger still.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hrolmog at the foot of the old steps.
steps.says: Good. Now Bulka knows your face, and you know where the food is.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the hill giants' first, at their home zone, West Plateau of the disc.

quests.name: Skinks in the Pits
quests.offer: Plateau skinks keep slipping into Bulka's meat pits. Go out on the grass west of the steps and stamp on five of them. Mind you do not stamp on Bulka.
quests.started: Five skinks. They are quick, so be quicker.

steps.journal: Kill five plateau skinks on the grass west of the old steps.
Tell Elder Hrolmog the skinks are dealt with.
steps.says: Five fewer thieves. You have heavy feet, young one. Good feet.

quests.notes: Ours: the hill giants' second starter quest, the elder's too (the owner's 2026-11-10: an elder giving two starter quests); the plateau skinks are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Stone Way
quests.offer: The ogres of Oggok are strong, and they will train you as one of their own. I can open the stone way across the sea to them, but it opens one way only. Are you ready to go?
quests.started: Stand still and hold your breath. Walk tall in Oggok!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thundrik when you are ready to go to Oggok.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Oggok, the hill giants' wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so one back in the homeland is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: Whiskers and Welcome
quests.offer: A new cub on the isle! Before you go prowling, every young one of the village greets Miyanne at the water's edge. She feeds the whole village, and she will feed you too.
quests.started: Go on. Miyanne keeps her stall by the water.

steps.journal: Greet Grocer Miyanne by the water's edge.
steps.says: Ssharu sent you? Here, a boiled egg. Do not eat the shell.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Ssharu on the village's landward side.
steps.says: Good. Now you know where the food is, and Miyanne knows your face.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the kerrans' first, at their home zone, Kerra Isle of the disc.

quests.name: Crabs on the Sand
quests.offer: Isle crabs crawl up the beach and pinch holes in our nets. Hunt five of them on the sand north of the village, and watch your tail.
quests.started: Five crabs. Pounce, do not paw.

steps.journal: Kill five isle crabs on the sand north of the village.
Tell Elder Ssharu the crabs are dealt with.
steps.says: Five fewer pinchers. You hunt well for a cub.

quests.notes: Ours: the kerrans' second starter quest, the elder's too (the owner's 2026-11-10: an elder giving two starter quests); the isle crabs are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: Across the Water
quests.offer: The humans of Qeynos trade with our boats and train our young as their own; rangers and druids go to their Surefall Glade. I can send you across the water, but the way runs one way. Are you ready?
quests.started: Keep your claws sharp and your fur dry!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Raszhar when you are ready to cross to Qeynos.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Qeynos, the kerrans' wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so one back in the homeland is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: Fresh from the Shell
quests.offer: Another young one, fresh from the shell! Before you go wading off, greet Pemmi, who keeps the Dwell's stores on the east sand. Nobody in the Dwell goes hungry while Pemmi has a say.
quests.declined: The Dwell will wait for you.
quests.started: Go on. Pemmi is on the sand to the east.

steps.journal: Greet Grocer Pemmi on the east sand of the Dwell.
steps.says: Hoshuk sent you? Then take this loaf, and keep it dry!

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hoshuk on the sand north of the Dwell.
steps.says: Good. Now you will not starve, and Pemmi will not forget you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the kappa's first, at their home zone, Sylhilthis' Dwell of the disc.

quests.name: Rats in the Reeds
quests.offer: Marsh rats have dug into the reeds where the causeway meets the shore. Cross over and drive off five of them before they reach our stores.
quests.declined: Then the stores will be gnawed.
quests.started: Five rats. Keep your shell between you and their teeth.

steps.journal: Kill five marsh rats on the shore where the causeway comes in.
Tell Elder Hoshuk the rats are dealt with.
steps.says: Five fewer gnawers. The stores are safe, young one.

quests.notes: Ours: the kappa's second starter quest, the elder's too (the owner's 2026-11-10: an elder giving two starter quests); the marsh rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: Down the River
quests.offer: The halflings of Rivervale welcomed the first of us who went down the river, and they will train you too. I can send you to them, but the current runs one way. Are you ready?
quests.started: Swim strong, and keep your shell clean!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Kabbo when you are ready to go to Rivervale.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Rivervale, the kappa's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so one back in the homeland is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: A New Pup in the Warren
quests.offer: Yip! A new pup in the warren. Before you go digging, greet Snivvet at the stalls. She trades for the whole clan, and a pup who knows her never goes hungry.
quests.started: Go. Snivvet is at the stalls, just west of here.

steps.journal: Greet Grocer Snivvet at the cavern's stalls.
steps.says: Grikkis sent you? Then take some dried beef, pup. Do not share it.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Grikkis by the stalls.
steps.says: Good. Snivvet knows your snout now, and you know her stall.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the kobolds' first, at their home zone, The Warrens of the disc.

quests.name: Beetles in the Tunnels
quests.offer: Tunnel beetles have crawled up from the deep ways at the west end of the cavern. Crack five of them before they chew through our props.
quests.started: Five beetles. Hit them where the shell is thin.

steps.journal: Kill five tunnel beetles at the cavern's west end.
Tell Elder Grikkis the beetles are dealt with.
steps.says: Five beetles cracked. The props will hold. Good pup.

quests.notes: Ours: the kobolds' second starter quest, the elder's too (the owner's 2026-11-10: an elder giving two starter quests); the tunnel beetles are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Deep Ways
quests.offer: The gnomes of Klick'Anon pay well for our tunnel lore, and they will teach you their trades in turn. I can send you through the deep ways to them, but the ways run one way. Are you ready?
quests.started: Mind your tail in the gnome city!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Ruknar when you are ready to go to Klick'Anon.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Klick'Anon, the kobolds' wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so one back in the homeland is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: A New Whisker
quests.offer: Hss, a new whisker in the camp. Before you go scurrying, greet Nibbla by the shacks. She keeps the camp's food, and she remembers who greets her and who does not.
quests.started: Go. Nibbla is by the shacks to the east.

steps.journal: Greet Grocer Nibbla by the camp's shacks.
steps.says: Skritch sent you? Then have some cheese, whisker. The good kind.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Skritch in the shore camp.
steps.says: Good. Now Nibbla will feed you, and you will not steal from her.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the ratmen's first, at their home zone, The Vastly Deep of the disc.

quests.name: Snakes on the Shore
quests.offer: Dune snakes come down the shore east of the camp and steal our eggs. Go east along the water and kill five of them.

steps.journal: Kill five dune snakes on the shore east of the camp.
Tell Elder Skritch the snakes are dealt with.
steps.says: Five snakes gone. The eggs are safe, and you are quick.

quests.notes: Ours: the ratmen's second starter quest, the elder's too (the owner's 2026-11-10: an elder giving two starter quests); the dune snakes are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: Into the Deep Halls
quests.offer: The dwarves of Moradhim let us dig beside them in their deep halls, and they will train you. I can send you down to them, but the way runs one way. Are you ready?
quests.started: Keep your nose to the stone!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Ksarr when you are ready to go to Moradhim.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Moradhim, the ratmen's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so one back in the homeland is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: A Fledgling's Welcome
quests.offer: Another fledgling, fresh from the egg! Before you take wing, every young one of the Roost greets our grocer, Skreel, by the market nests. She will see you do not fly hungry.
quests.declined: The Roost will wait for you, little one.
quests.started: Go on, then. Skreel keeps the nests to the east.

steps.journal: Greet Grocer Skreel by the Roost's market nests.
steps.says: The elder sent you? Then take this for the road, fledgling.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Kraawk.
steps.says: Good. Now you know where to find your food, and Skreel knows your face.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-08): the aviaks' first, at their home zone, Aviak Village of the disc.

quests.name: Rats Among the Seed
quests.offer: Scrub rats have been at the seed stores again. Thin them out for me: five of them, out on the grass south of the nests.
quests.declined: Then the rats eat well tonight.
quests.started: Five of them. Mind their teeth.

steps.journal: Kill five scrub rats on the grass south of the Roost.
Tell Grocer Skreel the rats are dealt with.
steps.says: Five fewer thieves at the seed. Thank you, fledgling!

quests.notes: Ours: the aviaks' second starter quest; the rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Long Flight
quests.offer: The winds are fair for the north, fledgling. The barbarians of Halas fight the giants beside us, and they will train you as their own. When you are ready, I will send you to them. Shall I?
quests.declined: The winds will wait for you.
quests.started: Fly well, and do not forget the Roost!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Windwhistle when you are ready to fly to Halas.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Halas, the aviak's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a fledgling back in the Roost is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.
